signature.instructions:
text
TASK: Ultra-Conservative Image-Pair Triage + Verbatim Diff Reporting (Discard-Optimized)

You may receive up to TWO images:
- image_original (old) may be present or None
- image_reimage (new) may be present or None

OUTPUT (ABSOLUTE):
Return EXACTLY ONE JSON object with EXACTLY these keys and nothing else:
{"discard_image": true/false, "changes": "<message>"}
- No extra keys (no "reasoning").
- No markdown.
- No additional text outside the JSON.

========================================================
PRIMARY GOAL (OPTIMIZED TO DISCARD)
========================================================
This is a triage filter. Discard almost everything.
Set discard_image=false ONLY when you can prove a material, content-level change from pixels alone.
When unsure, DISCARD.

Default output (use whenever rules do not clearly force otherwise):
{"discard_image": true, "changes": "Images are identical - no changes"}

========================================================
CRITICAL CALIBRATION FROM PAST ERRORS (MUST FOLLOW)
========================================================
1) SINGLE IMAGE (one input is None): default to DISCARD.
   - Do NOT keep just because the single image is “readable” or “informational”.
   - Icons with short labels (e.g., “GM156 Service Programming”), app-mode tiles, small UI badges, etc. are NOT “substantial” and must be discarded.
   - Only keep a single image (discard_image=false) if it is clearly substantial, e.g.:
     - multiple readable paragraphs of text, OR
     - a full table with multiple readable cells/values, OR
     - a full technical diagram with multiple clearly labeled nodes/relationships that are readable.
   - Otherwise:
     * Non-informational single image (logo/watermark/blank/single line/icons): discard_image=true with the specified single-image message.
     * Minimal snippet/fragment/header: discard_image=true with the snippet message.

2) Logos/watermarks/brands alone are NON-INFORMATIONAL.
   - “general motors” / “GM” logo-only images must be discarded.
   - A blank page with a watermark (e.g., “GM Confidential”) is non-informational and must be discarded.

3) Technical diagrams are common; arrow/line differences are almost always trivial.
   - Never keep solely due to arrow/line routing/color/placement changes.
   - Keep only if a clearly readable labeled element/node/table text is added/removed/renamed and you can quote text verbatim.

========================================================
ANTI-HALLUCINATION (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
========================================================
- Report ONLY what is literally visible in pixels.
- Do NOT guess unreadable text.
- Text diffs are allowed ONLY if BOTH images are clearly readable AND you quote BOTH sides EXACTLY:
  "<Image 1 exact text>" → "<Image 2 exact text>"
  Preserve casing, punctuation, and spacing.

========================================================
NON-INFORMATIONAL (AUTO-DISCARD)
========================================================
Non-informational includes:
- blank/solid background,
- a single divider line,
- only a watermark/logo/brand mark,
- only simple UI glyphs/icons/symbols (including wrench/head/arrow style icons),
- tiny isolated characters with no context.

If BOTH images are non-informational, output EXACTLY:
{"discard_image": true, "changes": "Both images are non informational and contain only logos / etc.."}

========================================================
TRIVIAL DIFFERENCES (MUST DISCARD)
========================================================
Discard if differences are only:
- Styling (color/font/weight/underline/borders/highlights),
- Minor alignment/position/size,
- Cropping/resolution/compression/clarity with no new readable info,
- Watermark/logo presence/absence when underlying content is same,
- Whitespace-only or punctuation-only,
- Diagram arrow/line changes without a clear readable content change.

=> output discard_image=true with:
"Images are identical - no changes"

========================================================
WHEN TO KEEP (discard_image=false) — RARE
========================================================
Set discard_image=false ONLY if you can clearly verify at least one:
1) Readable word/number/date/unit/threshold changes (quote both sides verbatim).
2) Obvious table structure change (rows/columns) OR any clearly readable cell text/value change (quote both).
3) Unmistakable diagram/flow change where a clearly labeled node/box is added/removed/renamed AND labels are readable.
   - Renames REQUIRE verbatim quotes.
   - Do NOT claim added/removed if it could be outside crop or too low-res.

If keeping, "changes" MUST be formatted exactly:
"OVERVIEW: <1–2 sentence summary> | DETAILS: 1) <Location>: <Image1 exact> → <Image2 exact>; 2) ..."

========================================================
SPECIAL OVERRIDES (APPLY BEFORE ALL ELSE)
========================================================
CROSSED-OUT RULE:
If either image has a clear whole-image cross-out (large X/strikethrough across the entire image):
- {"discard_image": false, "changes": "Image 1 has been crossed out"}
- {"discard_image": false, "changes": "Image 2 has been crossed out"}

UNREADABLE / CANNOT VERIFY RULE:
If either image is too blurry/tiny/corrupted such that differences cannot be checked reliably:
{"discard_image": false, "changes": "Could not infer"}

========================================================
SINGLE-IMAGE HANDLING (one input is None)
========================================================
Default to discard_image=true.

1) If the single image is non-informational (logos/icons/symbols/blank/line):
{"discard_image": true, "changes": "Only one image which is non-informational and it contains <logo/watermark/blank block/single line/icons/etc.>"}

2) If it is only a minimal snippet/fragment/header:
{"discard_image": true, "changes": "Only one image which is a minimal snippet/fragment containing <brief description>"}

3) Only if clearly substantial & readable (multiple readable paragraphs, or a full table with multiple readable cells/values, or a full diagram with multiple clearly labeled nodes/relationships):
{"discard_image": false, "changes": "NoMatchFound"}

========================================================
BOTH IMAGES PRESENT — DECISION ORDER
========================================================
A) If both non-informational:
{"discard_image": true, "changes": "Both images are non informational and contain only logos / etc.."}

B) If one non-informational and the other informational:
{"discard_image": false, "changes": "<briefly describe the informational image> | Only one image is informational"}

C) If both informational:
- If identical OR only trivial differences OR ANY uncertainty:
{"discard_image": true, "changes": "Images are identical - no changes"}
- If a clearly verified meaningful difference exists (per “WHEN TO KEEP”):
{"discard_image": false, "changes": "OVERVIEW: ... | DETAILS: 1) ..."}
